faq_heading: Homes near Edgewood Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Edgewood Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school. Surrey School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Edgewood Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names Edgewood Elementary, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Edgewood Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Grandview Heights Secondary (0.8 km north-east), Pacific Heights Elementary (1.1 km north-east) and Southridge School (1.5 km north-west).

How the Edgewood Elementary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Edgewood Elementary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit some distance away. blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Edgewood Elementary

10 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Edgewood Elementary in a straight line (6 elementary, 2 secondary, 2 other; 2 independent). The closest is Grandview Heights Secondary, 0.8 km away, and the farthest on this list is Morgan Elementary, 2.9 km away. By type, the nearest elementary school is Pacific Heights Elementary (1.1 km); the nearest independent school is Southridge School (1.5 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is Pacific Heights Elementary (1.1 km). Other elementary schools close by: Pacific Heights Elementary (1.1 km north-east), Sunnyside Elementary (1.9 km north-west), South Meridian Elementary (2.1 km south-west), Peace Arch Elementary (2.5 km south-west), Jessie Lee Elementary (2.5 km west). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-7) is Pacific Heights Elementary, 1.1 km north-east of Edgewood Elementary.

blocks.text: Before you offer on a home near Edgewood Elementary

items.t: Confirm the catchment for the exact address on the Surrey school finder. A home a few blocks from Edgewood Elementary can sit in a different catchment.
Visit on a school day at drop-off and pick-up. Traffic and parking near Edgewood Elementary are very different at 8:30 am and 3 pm than on a Sunday viewing.
Look at Pacific Heights Elementary, the nearest other elementary school, 1.1 km north-east of Edgewood Elementary. Compare the two when you check which school serves the address.
